observations.fidelity_note: The speaker aligns the operational protocols of the trial with the cooperative values established throughout the discourse, ensuring the scheduling tool is bounded by governance mechanisms that prevent the emergence of an informal loyalty hierarchy.
observations.limitations: The plan is constrained to an eight-week trial duration; subsequent viability depends on the outcome of the committee-led review and member decision process.
observations.role_interpretation: The user confirms a finalized, comprehensive design for an eight-week scheduling trial intended to balance cooperative needs for coverage with stringent protections for member autonomy, privacy, and equitable access to paid hours.

source_evidence.text: The eight-week trial will now distinguish routine and urgent offers, keep routine offers open for the printed channel, allocate paid hours by requested-hours rotation, and trigger a separate staffing review when recurring gaps cross the prewritten threshold.
Decline histories remain private, while members can voluntarily request help with a barrier.
Guaranteed schedules, quiet windows, committee auditing, weekly distribution reports, the pause vote, and the final member decision all remain.

stance_components.stance_object_interpretation: Implementation of an eight-week scheduling trial with specific operational boundaries
Differentiation between routine and urgent offers to protect the accessibility of the printed channel
Allocation of paid hours using requested-hours rotation with an automated threshold-based staffing review

Governance safeguards including committee-led auditing, an anonymous pause vote, and a final member-led review

qualification_review.interpretation: The user has integrated all concerns—including channel timing, loyalty score risks, staffing thresholds, privacy/accommodation distinctions, and trial boundaries—into a finalized eight-week trial plan. All identified tensions were addressed through specific procedural safeguards, committee oversight, and a clear final decision-making mandate that prioritizes member control over automated fill rates.
qualification_review.limitations: While the trial is inherently prospective and results are pending, the procedural structure and the governance rules for evaluation and intervention (the pause vote) are complete and settled current conditions rather than unresolved qualifications.
